SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT

This Service Level Agreement is attached to and incorporated into the Master Services Agreement between Corvid Cloud, Inc. ("Provider") and Aldine Freight Co. ("Customer").

1. Availability. Provider will make the service available 99.9% of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance.

2. Service Credits. If availability falls below 99.9%, Customer may claim a credit of 10% of the monthly subscription fees. Customer must request a credit within 30 days.

3. Sole Remedy. Service credits are the sole and exclusive remedy of Customer for a failure to meet the availability commitment.

4. Chronic Failure. If availability falls below 99.0% in three consecutive months, Customer may terminate the affected service.

5. Support. Provider will respond to severity 1 incidents within one hour.
